# llms.txt

> Qouver: a home for systems and ideas. Finds overlooked opportunities, turns
> them into useful systems, and shares what it learns.

## About

Qouver is the personal site of a systems-minded builder. It presents a curated
set of projects, an about page describing the person behind the work, and a
contact page. The site is fully static: every page is prerendered HTML with
zero client-side JavaScript.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://qouver.com/): Overview of what Qouver is about: systems, ideas, and selected work.
- [Projects](https://qouver.com/projects/): Catalog of projects, each with a title, description, and stack.
- [About](https://qouver.com/about/): Who is behind Qouver, approach, and philosophy.
- [Contact](https://qouver.com/contact/): Ways to get in touch.

## Highlights

- Fully static site built with the Jaspr framework (Dart), prerendered at build time.
- Every page ships title + meta description + canonical + OpenGraph tags, server-side.
- No client-side JavaScript: content is readable by any crawler without rendering.
- sitemap.xml is generated at build time from the route list.
